entries.referenceMarkdown:
### Follow the Pack

*One hunter moves and another flows into its wake, tightening the circle without a sound.*

After a visible active ally ends voluntary movement adjacent to a visible enemy within 3 squares of this creature, move up to 2 squares, ending adjacent to that ally. Pay normal terrain costs and provoke normally. The ally must be conscious and not Paralyzed; an uncommanded summon cannot trigger this. No attack or command is granted, and movement granted by a free attack cannot trigger it.

details.generalMarkdown:
### General details

**Basic Melee:** One adjacent creature; physical damage; Agility defense. Uses the printed Threat. No specialty riders.

**Defend:** Player attacks suffer 1 additional Bane until the start of its next turn. Combines with Evasion through normal Boon/Bane rules. Repeated Defend does not stack.

**Opportunity Attack:** Basic Melee against the provoking creature. Spends its Reaction before the provoking action resolves. That action continues if the creature remains capable.

**Pack Hunter:** When attacking a target adjacent to another active ally, impose 1 additional Bane on that target’s defense (or gain 1 attack Boon when controlled). Unconscious, Paralyzed and uncommanded summoned allies do not qualify.

**Healing:** Living: ordinary HP healing applies.

**Senses:** Keen scent within 6 squares.

**Signs:** Parallel tracks keep to the downwind side of the trail.

**Purpose:** Drive intruders from a den or bring food back to it.

**Tactics and retreat:** Use Pack Hunter against an isolated target; flee once half the pack is down.

**Counterplay and conversation:** Stay together, protect the flanks, and leave a clear route back to the den.

**Habitat:** Wilderness · **Communication:** None

**Loot:** A den may hold a lost traveler’s belongings; the wolf carries no coins.

**Summoning:** Animal 1 — [player reference](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/bestiary/summons/wolf.md).
details.designNotesMarkdown:
## Design notes — not needed during play

**ID:** creature-wolf


**Category:** Animal · **Role:** Pack hunter · **CV:** 9

**Difficulty rationale:** An agile or elusive body warrants attack Banes. Ordinary attack difficulty; riders and positioning carry the threat.

**Reference damage:** 2/3/4

**Reference type:** physical

**Expected targets:** 1

**Utility factor:** 1.3

**Action review (#1279):** U 1.2 → 1.3: Maneuver allowance +0, Reaction allowance +0.1. These are provisional judgments for the changed capabilities, counting the largest increment in each category rather than adding every alternative. Reactions compete for one budget; no measured balance claim.

**Regeneration per turn:** 0

Reference I=4.404, O=2.000. CV uses the [seed worksheet](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/bestiary/encounters.md); action choices, Stability and control are not simulated. Recalibration remains required.

**Ability sources:** [Follow the Pack](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/monster-abilities/follow-the-pack.md), [pack hunter](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/monster-abilities/pack-hunter.md), [wolf circle the prey](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/monster-abilities/wolf-circle-the-prey.md).

# Follow the Pack

*One hunter moves and another flows into its wake, tightening the circle without a sound.*

## Rules

**ID:** monster-follow-the-pack

**Action:** Reaction

After a visible active ally ends voluntary movement adjacent to a visible enemy within 3 squares of this creature, move up to 2 squares, ending adjacent to that ally. Pay normal terrain costs and provoke normally. The ally must be conscious and not Paralyzed; an uncommanded summon cannot trigger this. No attack or command is granted, and movement granted by a free attack cannot trigger it.
